title: Marrying Odessa in Boston on Decoration Day
summary: On his $75 blackjack winnings he brought Odessa to Boston and tipped an elevator man to get the license so they could marry before leaving.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So she come to Boston. I'll never forget it. So she told me she couldn't continue living with me, she said. She said, 'I'll have to go back home. I can't continue living with you.' I said, 'Well, I'm going to fix that.' So we got up the next morning and I said, 'C'mon, we're going downtown.' She said, 'What are we going down there for?' I said, 'We're going down to City Hall because I'm going to fix it so you don't leave me no more.'
That sounds like the last story.
That's right, that's right.
(Laughter.)
I said, 'I'll fix it so you don't leave me no more.' So we went down and applied for the license. And we was playing the Southland, the club the Southland, at the time.
Uh-huh.
We was staying at a hotel called the Regent Hotel, I think it was called.
Uh-huh.
All of us was staying there. Tyree was staying there. Chu Berry and a bunch of us. Dizzy and Lorraine, Dizzy Gillespie.

And we came back in town and I'm going to get the marriage license and I found out it was Decoration Day and the city building was closed. I said, 'Oh, Lord, what am I going to do?' So I went by the city building and I found out it was closed, and this man was an elevator man. I told him, 'Please,' I said, 'what am I going to do?' I said, 'You know, I got to marry this girl. I'm going to leave here tomorrow and I've got to marry her now.' I said, 'Please, I need some help. Is there any way you can help me?'
He said, 'Well, I'll go up and look to see if the marriage license is ready. If it is, why, I'll give it to you.' And I gave him $3 --
Wow.
-- to go up there. And the marriage license was ready because the five days was up. You know, there was a five day period.
Right.

And so he sent me -- I said, 'Where can I get married?' And he told me how to go out to this justice of the peace. And we had to take the El, that El up there in Boston, we had to take it out. And the justice of the peace, he was a white guy and he had a white lady there
visiting him, you see, and she was our witness.
Wow.
And he performed the ceremony and we got married right there.
That's beautiful.
That's right.
